response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN riskandmargin AS r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), overall AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(t.order_count) AS avg_count_above_average, AVG(t.order_count - a.avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM type_counts AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE t.order_count > a.avg_count
